**Finding submitted — deviation (medium).**

- **Clause:** § 12.4 (p0045) — one-way, 24-month prohibition on Customer soliciting, hiring, or employing *any* Vendor employee, expressly applying "regardless of how the employee applies."
- **Why it fails the rule:** It is a no-hire (not merely a non-solicit), unilateral against us, covers all Vendor personnel rather than those involved in the Services, runs 24 months, and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-applicant carve-out. It also conflicts with § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** delete § 12.4 in full; comment offers the fallback of a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
